questions.question: Analyze the impact of mobile journalism on traditional news media. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Mobile journalism has significantly impacted traditional news media by shifting
  • the focus to real-time, on-the-go reporting. With smartphones enabling journalists
  • to capture, edit, and share content instantly, news cycles have become faster,
  • challenging traditional media’s reliance on lengthy production processes. It has
  • also democratized news creation, allowing citizen journalists to contribute, while
  • encouraging established outlets to adopt mobile-first strategies. This shift has led
  • to more accessible, diverse, and immediate news coverage, but it also poses
  • challenges to traditional media in terms of credibility, quality control, and
  • monetization models.
